about: Which reels I have sent insights screenshots for (from 2026-10-18). After every delivered reel Claude asks for exactly one reel, chosen by `node ig.mjs review` (the ASK AFTER DELIVERY line): 48 hours old or more, and not listed here. When I send them, Claude records the reel here and the numbers in VIDEOS.md (Results), and an English reel's tier-1 share in results/countries.json. Per-reel follows and profile visits (the "Profile activity" part) go into follows, visits and reach (accounts reached when the screenshot was taken); node ig.mjs report ranks what drives follows once 5 reels have them.
